rubrics.justification: The response overcalls image quality: the blastocoel is not clearly occupying most of the embryo, the ICM is not distinctly compact, and TE cohesion is not convincingly visible. It relies heavily on the provided 3AA label and adds features not well supported by the image.

It integrates age, BMI, prior cycle, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, diagnosis, and ovarian reserve context reasonably well with embryo quality, though some inferences are stronger than the available data support.
The structure is logical and the prognosis estimate generally follows from age and embryo grade, but there is some overconfidence in morphology-based conclusions and a few speculative links.

SET recommendation and general counseling are guideline-consistent, but endorsing ERA, immune/thrombophilia workup, routine estradiol addition, and strong PGT-A recommendation after limited failure goes beyond standard evidence-based guidance.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested tests/interventions are not well-indicated at this stage and may reduce appropriateness.
